meta.title: YotoMediaManager · The songs they ask for, on their Yoto
meta.description: A desktop app for parents with a Yoto at home: import audio from a file or a YouTube link, trim it, and add it to a playlist on your Yoto account. For macOS and Windows.
meta.ogDescription: Import a song, keep just the right part, and add it to a playlist on their Yoto. A desktop app for macOS and Windows.
meta.imageAlt: YotoMediaManager: the songs they ask for, on their Yoto. Beside the line, the app's playlist editor with four nursery rhymes saved on Yoto.

hero.badge: For parents with a Yoto at home
hero.title: The songs they ask for,
hero.sub: A nursery rhyme found on YouTube, a story in your language, Grandma’s lullaby: import it, keep just the right part, and add it to a playlist on your player.
hero.note: macOS and Windows · works with your Yoto account

how.title: Four steps, one place
how.sub: No more juggling a converter, an audio editor and the Yoto website.

steps.title: Import
steps.text: Paste a YouTube link or choose an audio file on your computer.

steps.title: Trim
steps.text: Cut the intro or the credits. The original is always kept.

steps.title: Compose
steps.text: Create a playlist, add your tracks and give each one its little icon.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: Pick the player in the bedroom and start the playlist from the app.

import.title: Paste a link, get the song
import.text: Paste a public YouTube video or playlist, or add a file from your computer. The audio is downloaded on your computer and waits in your library, ready to listen to.
import.alt: Animation of the app: a YouTube link is pasted into Import audio and Import is pressed; the task appears under Activity, downloads, then is ready in the library, and Listen opens the song in the Library.

trim.title: Keep just the right part
trim.text: Drag the two handles past the intro and the credits, and click the waveform to listen from any spot. Apply keeps your original and creates the trimmed version for your playlists.
trim.alt: Animation of the trim dialog: the start and end handles are dragged inward, a click on the waveform moves the playhead, the selection plays from there, then Apply prepares the trimmed version.

playlist.title: Straight onto their Yoto
playlist.text: Choose Add media, tick a song from your library and the version to send. Once Yoto has it, it appears in the playlist; click its empty icon slot to give it its little pixel icon. Changes are saved to your Yoto account as you go: there is no publish button.
playlist.alt: Animation of the playlist editor: Add media opens a dialog, a trimmed song is ticked and added; once sent to Yoto it appears as a new track, its empty icon slot opens Choose an icon, an icon is used, and the playlist shows Saved on Yoto.

features.title: What you can do
features.sub: Your files stay on your computer. Your playlists live on your Yoto account, and changes are sent there directly.

items.text: Import audio files or paste a YouTube link.
Listen and trim your audio while keeping the original.
Create and edit playlists directly on your Yoto account.
Choose Yoto’s pixel art icons or upload your own images.
Choose a player and control playback from the app.

story.title: One parent, a toddler and a handful of songs
story.body: Yoto has a wonderful catalogue. But my two-year-old had a much shorter wish list: a few favourite nursery rhymes, on repeat. The ones we loved were on YouTube, and often not in our language. Yoto lets families bring their own audio and opens its API to developers, so I brought every step into one app.

items.q: Is this an official Yoto app?
items.a: No. YotoMediaManager is an independent app, built on the API Yoto makes available to developers. You sign in with your own Yoto account, on Yoto’s website.
Your library stays on your computer. Only the audio you add to a playlist is sent to your Yoto account.

items.q: Do I need a Yoto account?
items.a: Not to import and trim audio. To create playlists and play them on a player, yes.

items.q: Are my originals changed when I trim?
items.a: Never. Trimming creates a version next to the original, which you can export at any time.
It is still being validated: some combinations of players and computers remain to be tested. The app tells you when a feature is not available, and offers new versions as soon as they are published.

pl.pickerLead: Select your media and the version to send.
pl.pickerNote: The audio is sent to Yoto before it appears in your playlist. No icon? Choose one in the Library, or later in the playlist.
